Phase 4a test contract card:
authoritative_contract: ticket A1 plus ADR 0026 (retain exact last-synced values; absent baseline degrades local-wins; corruption fails closed).
trigger_preconditions: confirmed binding with five mirrored fields; repeat same baseline under two distinct clock values; contrast with a changed field and a present-null field; real second reconcile pass over unchanged fake Jira state.
production_path: BindingStore.set_baseline -> BindingStore.save; seed_baselines_from_snapshot; reconcile._advance_baselines -> commit helper in a real temp git tracker.
test_tier: focused real-store unit for serialization/shape; existing stateful-fake integration strengthened for exact bindings bytes and HEAD commit identity. One tier lower cannot prove git commit suppression.
observable_postcondition: no baseline_advanced_at, exact mirrored baseline including None, unchanged input preserves serialized bytes and tracker HEAD, changed input persists and changes bytes.
negative_control: A->B baseline update must write.
collateral_invariants: extraneous fields remain filtered, unbound is still no-op, version-1 and corrupt-store behavior unchanged.
ci_gate: exact pytest nodes, then make test.
Current citations: BindingStore.set_baseline lines 451-464; _advance_baselines 520-536; inbound getattr call 257-260; seed caller 466-480. Prior line references are superseded.
